newsitem.title: USA: NFL-WR HARPER SIGNS WITH REDSKINS.
newsitem.headline: NFL-WR HARPER SIGNS WITH REDSKINS.

text.p: Wide receiver Alvin Harper signed with the Washington Redskins on Wednesday, one day after being released by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
Although terms were not disclosed, ESPN reported that Harper signed a three-year deal worth $3.5 million.
Harper played his first four seasons in the NFL with the Dallas Cowboys, averaging almost 25 yards per catch on 33 receptions in 1994 with eight touchdowns.
At Washingon Harper will be reunited with Redskins head coach Norv Turner, who was the Cowboys offensive coordinator when Harper played for Dallas.
"I've worked with Alvin, I know what his strengths are," said Turner. "He's a big play receiver, and can definitely help our team."

Turner joined Tampa Bay as a free agent in 1995 and registered a career-high 46 receptions, but averaged just 13.8 yards per catch. Last season he dropped off to 19 catches for 289 yards and one touchdown.
He had two years left on a four-year contract worth $10 million, but was released by Tampa Bay to clear room under the salary cap.

Harper is the second free agent in as many days to sign with the Redskins, who landed defensive end Chris Mims on Tuesday. Defensive backs Cris Dishman and Jesse Campbell also signed with Washington as free agents this off season.
